jobs.description: Finance Affiliate & IB Management Platform - Cellxpert Product ▼ Overview Learn more about our product Dimensions of Trust Build trust and transparency Industries ▼ Finance IB & affiliate partnership iGaming Affiliate platform for iGaming operators eCom Optimize for sales Company ▼ About Us Why the world trusts us Career Join our team Partners Expand your business Blog Book a Demo Product Overview Dimensions of Trust Industries Finance iGaming eCom Company About Us Career Partners Blog Book a Demo Finance & Forex IB Platform IB management built for the complexity of regulated Forex operations Multi-tier IB hierarchies with real-time rebate calculations, native MT4, MT5 and cTrader integration, and audit-ready reporting. 18 years Regulated experience 800+ Global operators MT4 · MT5 · cTrader Native integration Book a Demo IB Programme · MT5 Live Feed Rebate volume · MTD Position closed · 14:32 $ 342,108 Per-symbol · live MT5 attribution EURUSD 2,184 lots $18.2k XAUUSD 892 lots $14.6k GBPJPY 418 lots $6.4k IB hierarchy · attributed traders Real-time IB apex_capital UK 412 traders $84.2k Sub-IB meridian_fx CY 168 traders $31.7k Sub-IB cedar_partners AE 124 traders $22.4k Sub-Sub-IB horizon_desk ZA 58 traders $9.8k Trusted by regulated Forex brokers across global markets The problem space The realities of IB and affiliate management at enterprise scale Running IB and affiliate programmes at scale brings operational, regulatory, and attribution complexity that generic platforms were never designed for. This is the complexity Cellxpert’s Finance platform was built around. 01 The MT4 reconciliation that eats two days every month-end Positions close in MT4. Commissions calculate in your affiliate system. The two never quite match. The discrepancy could be a data lag, a calculation error, or an IB gaming the model, and you cannot tell which. Two days of manual work at month-end to find $12,000 that should not exist is not a data problem; it is a platform problem. 02 Multi-tier IB structures no generic platform was designed to handle Master IB recruits sub IB 1, who recruits sub IB 2, who recruits sub IB 3. Each tier has different rebate structures, different data visibility, and different reporting requirements. A platform built for flat IB relationships cannot model this without workarounds, and the workarounds compound until the whole structure is managed partly in spreadsheets. 03 The gap between a click, a trade, and a rebate is where your data falls apart A trader registers. Funds their account. Executes positions over six months. Which IB gets the rebate, at what rate, for which positions? The attribution chain runs from a click through CRM, through MT4, through position data, through your rebate model. Generic platforms break somewhere in that chain. When they do, IBs email asking where their money is. 04 The audit trail your compliance team needs, and cannot get Your compliance officer needs a clean audit trail of every IB relationship, every commission payment, every KYC document, every consent record. Your current platform was not built for this. At audit time you export to Excel and manually compile what should be a one-click report. That is a regulatory risk, not just an inconvenience. Platform capabilities Capabilities built for Finance Multi-tier IB and affiliate structures, real-time rebate, CPA and commission calculations, MT4, MT5 and cTrader integration, and regulatory reporting, built specifically for Finance and Forex partnerships. The all-in-one platform for IBs, affiliates, affiliate networks, influencers, streamers, marketing campaigns and more. IB Interface and Dashboard IBs log into a dashboard built around trading activity: open and closed positions, trade volumes, rebate and commission calculations, and payment history, plus granular metrics on their attributed trader accounts, deposits, withdrawals, and account status. IBs see what you see, in real time, with operator-controlled visibility at every tier. Affiliate Interface and Dashboard Affiliates log into a separate module built around conversion metrics: clicks, registrations, first-time deposits, conversion rates, and commission. A distinct dashboard and user experience, tuned to how affiliates work, with operator-controlled visibility at every tier. Signature Multi-Tier IB and Affiliate Hierarchies Run IB and affiliate programmes with full sub-partner structures. IBs and affiliates can recruit and manage their own sub-partners with configurable rebate and commission pass-down. Multi-level trees with independent reporting at each tier. The commercial model you run today, configured exactly as-is. Real-Time Rebate and Commission Calculation Rebate and commission calculations update in real time as traders execute positions. IBs and affiliates see their earnings accumulate without waiting for month-end reconciliation. The recurring monthly discrepancy stops because the data is never out of sync. MT4, MT5 and cTrader Integration Native integration with MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and cTrader data feeds. Trade-level data attributed to the originating IB or affiliate in real time. Position-symbol support for per-symbol commission models. No data lag, no manual exports, no reconciliation gaps. Signature Click-to-Trade Attribution Full attribution chain for IBs and affiliates: first click, lead registration, account funding, trade execution, rebate calculation. Every event timestamped and auditable. The chain that closes the attribution gap your generic platform leaves open. Cashback and Rebate Structures Configure cashback programmes and tiered rebate models for IBs and affiliates. Different rebate rates by trade volume, by instrument, by trader tier. The commercial structure you need, without custom development. Add-on module Regulatory and Compliance Reporting Audit-ready reporting for regulatory frameworks. Every IB and affiliate relationship, every commission payment, every KYC record, every consent trail, exportable
